announcements.label: Help wanted
announcements.title: Help bring the recomps to Linux, Steam Deck and Mac
body: Every recomp is open source, and I want them to be the best way there is to play these games. Some things are bigger than one person, and that is where you come in:
- A Linux port, and with it the Steam Deck
- Testers with handhelds, wheels, light guns and unusual setups
If you can commit some time to one of these, say so in the discussion. Every contribution is credited in the project and in the launcher.

announcements.label: Testers wanted
announcements.title: Sega Rally 2 on Steam Deck: testers wanted
body: If you have a Steam Deck, I would like to know how Sega Rally 2 Native runs on it through Proton: what works, what does not, and how smooth it feels.
A short report with your settings is enough, and it helps decide what the Linux port needs first.
